name: ConViD — Concrete Visual Defect Dataset
author: Gayakwad, Milind
selection: Fixed seed52; 100 photos per author folder before existing data lookup; screen by decoded SHA and whole-photo dHash; do not refill
labels: Only the author folder class is positive; each photo leaves its other six public classes unknown. No spatial or auxiliary labels are asserted
source_environment: Author describes consumer-phone photographs of outdoor concrete defects in Pune, India. Facility type is unverified; not a factory evaluation dataset
limitations: Multiple angles of the same defect are described by the author. Hash screening does not prove scene independence. Author Spalling folder semantics may differ from strict concrete material loss; eight TRAIN photos were AI-inspected without expert relabeling. This is bounded supplemental training, not industrial field accuracy evidence
